memory_candidates.content: The literature-retrieve.sh / <literature-context> pattern mirrors memory-retrieve.sh but with key differences: no index (reads all files directly from specs/literature/), TOKEN_BUDGET=4000 (vs 2000 for memory), lit_flag gate is independent of clean_flag (--clean --lit works: suppresses memory but injects literature). Stage 4a injection block goes after memory retrieval; Stage 5 prompt placement goes AFTER <memory-context> and BEFORE task instructions.
